mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job (title, content, address, phone, imageUrl, userId, status, createTime, salary, time, remunerationType, category, recruitmentLimit, applicationCount, tags) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{imageUrl}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{salary}, #{time,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remunerationType}, #{category}, #{recruitmentLimit}, #{applicationCount}, #{tags,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE job SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, imageUrl = #{imageUrl}, userId = #{userId}, status = #{status}, createTime = #{createTime}, salary = #{salary}, time = #{time,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remunerationType = #{remunerationType}, category = #{category}, recruitmentLimit = #{recruitmentLimit}, applicationCount = #{applicationCount}, tags = #{tags,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job ORDER BY createTime DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_requirement (job_id, merchant_id, day_of_week, time_slot, needed_count, filled_count) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{merchantId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot}, #{neededCount}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE job SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_requirement (job_id, merchant_id, day_of_week, time_slot, needed_count, filled_count) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{merchantId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot}, #{neededCount}, #{filledCount})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT j.* FROM job j JOIN merchant_requirement mr ON mr.job_id = j.id WHERE j.status = '进行中' AND mr.day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND mr.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND mr.filled_count < mr.needed_count AND ( mr.day_of_week > CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) WHEN 1 THEN 7 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 END OR ( mr.day_of_week = CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) WHEN 1 THEN 7 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 END AND ( (mr.time_slot = 'morning' AND CURTIME() < '09:00:00') OR (mr.time_slot = 'afternoon' AND CURTIME() < '14:00:00') OR (mr.time_slot = 'evening' AND CURTIME() < '18:00:00') ) ) ) ORDER BY j.createTime DESC
